statements.impact_statement: The store's Go packages and tests do not import golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp or any of its subpackages. Verified with go list -deps -test ./... and govulncheck ./... on 2026-10-10. The module is retained for other crypto packages. This assessment applies only to this repository and x/crypto v0.57.0; reassess when dependencies or imports change.
